relations.text: 2020年からの提携で、店内の美容売り場をSephoraが独占(1,100店超に出店)
relations.text_en: Exclusive beauty partner since 2020, with shop-in-shops in over 1,100 stores

source.label: Kohl's 10-K(2026年1月期)
source.quote: In 2020, we entered into an arrangement with Sephora to be the exclusive beauty offering at Kohl's.

companies.name: コンツール・ブランズ

relations.text: Kontoor(Wrangler・Lee)が10-Kで、百貨店の顧客としてコールズを挙げる
relations.text_en: Kontoor (Wrangler, Lee) names Kohl's as a department store customer

source.label: Kontoor Brands 10-K(2024年度)
source.quote: Our department store customers include national retailers such as Kohl's as well as other retail partners.

companies.name: ジェネレーション・インカム・プロパティーズ

relations.text: Generation Incomeが10-K/Aで、賃料の10%超を占めるテナント5社の一社に挙げる
relations.text_en: Generation Income lists Kohl's among five tenants each over 10% of its rent

source.label: Generation Income Properties 10-K/A(2025年度)
source.quote: As of March 31, 2026, we have five tenants, that each account for more than 10% of our annualized rent: the General Service Administration, Dollar General, the City of San Antonio, Kohl's Corporation, and PRA Holdings

source.quote: Bay Park Square WI Green Bay Fee 100.0 % Built 1980 93.1 % 690,122 Kohl's, Marcus Cinema 16, Dave & Buster's, Steinhafel Furniture, Hy-Vee

relations.text: Macerichが10-Kで、自社保有の店舗をコールズに貸していると記載

source.label: Macerich 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: The Company owns one store located at a shopping center not owned by the Company, which is leased to Kohl's.

source.quote: Discount retailers with significant buying power, such as Walmart, Kohl's and J.C.
